VERIFY — load the manifest (missing/unparseable => verdict status unknown, reason manifest_missing, rc 2); if signed and key present, verify signature (bad => status red, reason signature_invalid); read <state>/runs-v2.jsonl line by line with json.loads, keep rows whose run_id equals the manifest's; compute missing (required roster nodes with no row), unexpected (row nodes not in roster), duplicates (nodes with >1 status ok row), reordered (first-occurrence ts order of required nodes disagrees with ordinal order); status red if any list non-empty else green, reason includes 'unsigned' when signature is null; write <state>/run-manifests/<run_id>.verdict.json (overwrite ok), append ONE observation row to <state>/observations.jsonl per the frozen shape (sensor runmanifest, status alarm for red / unknown for unknown), print summary JSON; rc 0 green, 2 red or unknown, 1 crash. Pure stdlib; ~250 lines; module docstring cites the spec. TESTS — create tests/test_run_manifest.py implementing ALL nine tests named in plan Task 1 Step 1 (fixture builder makes a fake dept tree: releases/current -> hash abc123, releases/abc123/manifest.json listing run-roster.json with its real sha256, runtime/run-roster.json with 3 nodes 2 required, empty state/).
